title: Certificates of Deposit: The Penalty Days the Terms Prescribe for a Given Penalty
content:
Judging the day count of a booked penalty on Certificates of Deposit at Piedmont Crescent Bank, the number of penalty days that the certificate terms prescribe for that particular penalty has to be known. This page defines that number.

## Definition

The prescribed penalty days are the tier's standard early withdrawal penalty days. The single exception concerns a penalty posted soon after the term began: when the penalty posted within six calendar days of the term's first day (six days at most), the prescribed penalty days are the greater of the tier's standard penalty days and the tier's six-day minimum.

The distance is measured in calendar days from the term start date to the penalty's posting date. A distance of six days or fewer brings in the six-day minimum; a distance of seven days or more leaves the standard figure alone.

## Condition, judgement, outcome (hypothetical tier: standard 120 days, six-day minimum 10 days)

| Term start date | Penalty posted | Days after term start | Prescribed penalty days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 3 May | 2 | the greater of 120 and 10, that is 120 |
| 1 May | 7 May | 6 | the greater of 120 and 10, that is 120 |
| 1 May | 8 May | 7 | 120 |

## Where the exception bites (hypothetical tier: standard 0 days, six-day minimum 10 days)

| Term start date | Penalty posted | Days after term start | Prescribed penalty days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 7 May | 6 | the greater of 0 and 10, that is 10 |
| 1 May | 8 May | 7 | 0 |

A penalty booked for a number of days different from the prescribed figure was booked for a number of days other than the one the terms set.
